title: The Ordinary Weather
author: Petra Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Dunmore, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
